reason: The README clearly describes a user-facing plugin for recognizing local images and generating images through configurable Codex, Gemini, and Zhipu engine fallbacks, with UI integration and temporary file handling.

summaries.en: Recognize local images and generate new images through configurable multi-engine fallbacks, with OCR, layout details, and conversation UI integration.
